name: sf-intelligence
description: Ask your AI what breaks before you change Salesforce. Offline, read-only, cited answers from an org's real metadata: field deletion safety, what runs on save, who can see a record, dependency impact. Serves a local org-kb vault built by the sfi CLI; try the bundled demo org with no Salesforce login. Not affiliated with Salesforce.

npm.description: Serve your org's vault (build it first with `npx -y sf-intelligence init --target-org <alias>` and `npx -y sf-intelligence refresh` in your Salesforce DX project). Equivalent to `npx -y sf-intelligence mcp --vault /absolute/path/to/org-kb`.

demo.description: Bundled synthetic demo org served over MCP, no Salesforce login or vault needed

SFI_VAULT.description: Absolute path to the org-kb vault built by `sfi init` + `sfi refresh`. If no vault is found the server starts in setup mode with one tool (sfi.setup_status).
